item.title: Fedora Workstation (GNOME) & Stylus/Eraser Bring-Up Plan for Google Jamboard
item.description: Overview This guide documents the end-to-end hardware architecture, reverse-engineering workflow, and installation procedure for running stock Fedora Workstation (aarch64, GNOME on Wayland)—with full multi-touch, passive stylus, physical eraser, and display backlight support—on a Google Jamboard (codename baracus). Because the Jamboard’s passive stylus and eraser currently lack complete tool-type/eraser handling in open-source ROMs, this plan uses a two-stage execution strategy:
